source.name: Pittsburgh Pirates: Jersey Patch (read via the Wayback Machine)
source.note: Club jersey-patch page, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2026-04-12 because the live mlb.com page blocks scripts. Undated page; the capture date is given. The page still names Sheetz as the club's jersey patch partner on the sleeves of the home and away jerseys; the club calls Sheetz its first jersey patch partner.
source.quote: the Pennsylvania-based retailer will have its logo featured on the sleeves of Pittsburgh Pirates home and away jerseys
